quote: we tested the benefits of studying multimodal DST for a response prediction task. Specifically, we used the best VDTN model to predict dialogue states across all samples in DVD-DST. We then used the predicted slots, including object identities and temporal slots, to select the video features. The features are the visual objects and segments that are parts of the predicted dialogue states. We then used these selected features as input to train new Transformer decoder models which are added with an MLP as the response prediction layer. Note that these models are trained only with a cross-entropy loss to predict answer candidates.
